messages.text: How do changes in automotive radar technology affect the measurement capability required from Vector Network Analyzer?

### Short answer
【推論】As automotive radar testing moves toward 76 GHz to 81 GHz mmWave frontends, dynamic FMCW artificial-object generation, and up to 5 GHz IF bandwidth, the VNA requirement expands toward mmWave coverage or converter support, wide-span IF characterization, time-domain measurement, fine frequency stepping, and high dynamic-range level measurement [40][34][8][9][15][25][3].
### Supported details
- Automotive radar echo generation in the passages includes dynamic artificial object generation; the digital concept is for FMCW radar, with maximum generated distance of 3000 m [34].  
- The automotive radar frontend bands listed include 76 GHz to 81 GHz for R&S AREG8-81S / AREG8-81D / AREG8-81WS / AREG8-81WD and R&S QAT100, while the AREG800A base unit instantaneous IF bandwidth can be 1 GHz, 2 GHz, or 5 GHz depending on option [40].  
- For AREG800A IF transfer characterization, the VNA measurement conditions are frequency step size 2.5 MHz, measurement bandwidth 1 kHz, source power –10 dBm, and spans including 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, and 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz [9].  
- For ghost-object suppression, the measurement condition explicitly uses a vector network analyzer in time domain with 125 kHz frequency step size, 100 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power, 2 m distance to the wanted artificial object, and spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz [8].  
- The R&S ZNA base VNA family covers up to 67 GHz, while the R&S ZNA67EXT VNA system covers 10 MHz to 110 GHz, so 76 GHz to 81 GHz radar work needs either higher-frequency VNA system coverage or mmWave converter support rather than only a base 67 GHz instrument [24][15][40].  
- R&S ZNA supports optional rear-panel LO output for mmWave converters, with up to four converters on a 4-port model and up to two converters on a 2-port model, without an external signal generator [25].  
- R&S ZNA performance figures relevant to level-sensitive measurements include dynamic range >129 dB without options, 147 dB typical with options, maximum attainable range up to 170 dB, and 100 dB typical continuous electronic power sweep range [3].

R&S ZNA › Measurement speed
- Measurement speed 測試條件：firmware version 3.20、Windows 11 (64 bit)。
- Acquisition time per point：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog wideband 時 1 µs；30 MHz measurement bandwidth 時 32 ns。
- Linear frequency sweep 條件 201 points、10 GHz center frequency、200 MHz span：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog normal 時 time per sweep < 3.9 ms；sweep cycle time < 4.9 ms。
- IEC/IEEE VXI11 over 1 Gbit/s LAN：201 measurement points、800 MHz start frequency、1 GHz stop frequency、1 MHz measurement bandwidth 的 measurement and data transfer time 為 14 ms / 13 ms；201 measurement points magnitude 的 data transfer time 為 1.7 ms / 0.9 ms。
- Switching time between channels with a maximum of 2001 points：< 2 ms。
- Continuous mode 不需要額外 data transfer time，因為 data transfer 與 measurement 同時進行。

R&S ZNA › 重要 recommended setups
- [[R&S ZNA-K5]] vector corrected converter measurements：recommended setup 為 4-port R&S®ZNA；需要 R&S®ZNA-K4、R&S®ZNA-B5、R&S®ZNA-B8 mmWave converter LO、R&S®ZN-ZM292 calibration mixer 與 calibration accessories。
- [[R&S ZNA-K8]] mmWave converter support：two mmWave converters with 2-port R&S®ZNA，或 four mmWave converters with 4-port R&S®ZNA；需要 R&S®ZNA-K8、R&S®ZNA-B8、R&S®ZNA-B26、R&S®ZCAKN 與 accessories。Alternative setup：two mmWave converters with 4-port R&S®ZNA，需要 R&S®ZNA-K8、R&S®ZNAxx-B16、R&S®ZCAKN 與 accessories。
- [[R&S ZNA-K9]] group delay measurements：4-port R&S®ZNA recommended setup 需要 R&S®ZNAxx-B213、R&S®ZNA-B5、R&S®ZNA-K9；2-port R&S®ZNA recommended setup 需要 R&S®ZNAxx-B212、R&S®ZNAxx-B52、R&S®ZNA-K9。
- [[R&S ZNA-K30]] noise figure measurement：recommended setup 使用 port 1 as driving and port 2 as receiving port；需要 R&S®ZNAxx-B16、R&S®ZNAxx-B21、R&S®ZNAxx-B32、R&S®ZNAxx-B161、R&S®ZNAxx-B302、diode power sensor（例如 R&S®NRP40S）與 accessories（test cables、fixed attenuators 3 dB / 6 dB / 10 dB 等）。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。
- Speed example：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 與既有知識的關係

電信技術中心 › 毫米波測試量能
[[低軌衛星通信終端設備技術規範與相關檢測]]介紹電信技術中心毫米波頻段測試量能：

- 5G FR2 毫米波天線縮距量測場 CATR。
- 來源稱該 chamber 依據 3GPP 技術規範標準，已通過 TAF 認證。
- 支援主波發射頻段 3–40 GHz。
- 不必要發射可至 90 GHz。
- 可量測 TRP、TIS、EVM。
- Quiet Zone 可達 90 cm。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 為什麼需要 OTA 與 multiple RF chains
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 指出，在 WLAN devices development 期間，需要在 real-world conditions in signaling mode 下量測 antennas 以及 RF transmitter / receiver characteristics。由於 [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很關鍵。

同一來源同時將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester；其 flexibility、support for multiple radio technologies 與 embedded IP test capabilities 使其可用於 broad range of Wi-Fi 7-specific tests。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 進一步把 Wi-Fi 7 OTA 測試放入更廣的 [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 情境：同一 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] / [[Bluetest]] RTS workflow 同時涵蓋 WiFi、[[LTE]]、5G SA / NSA 的 radio and antenna performance validation。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 沒有使用 MIMO stress testing 一詞，也沒有提供 RF chains、spatial streams 或 chamber reflection model；它的貢獻是確認另一個 OTA chamber vendor [[EMITE]] 也將 [[R&S CMX500]] 整合到 [[Wi-Fi 7]] OTA measurement solution 中。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 與既有 NGeCall / hybrid eCall 頁面的關係
- [[NGeCall over LTE]] 整理 CMW500 與 CMX500 capability lists，本頁只整理 PR 中的 Qualcomm / Snapdragon verification event。
- [[CMX500 NGeCall configuration]] 整理 configuration guide 的 mandatory / optional items，本頁不取代正式 configuration 或 quote。
- [[Hybrid eCall testing]] 以 EN 18052:2025 與 hybrid fallback 為核心；本頁聚焦 EN 17240:2024 NG eCall verification，不描述 classic CS fallback 或 EN 18052 test scope。
- [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 提到 EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 與 cetecom advanced certification testing；本頁來源只提 EN 17240:2024，且未說第三方 certification report。

欣銓 › 來源中的說法
- [[Power IC - Power Management IC]] 在功率半導體封測區塊將 [[欣銓]] 寫為「車用與功率IC測試核心廠」。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S ZNB3020
[[R&S ZNB3020]] 是 [[R&S ZNB3000]] 系列的 20 GHz Vector Network Analyzer 型號，依 Version 09.00（July 2026）base frequency range 為 9 kHz to 20.0 GHz，搭配 frequency upgrade option 可到 26.5 GHz。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 測試需求
依 [[R&S for JIO Project]] 與 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]]，WoMT 測試至少包含：

- OTA precision measurement：使用 [[R&S ATS1800C]] CATR chamber。
- TX analysis：[[EIRP]]、[[TRP]]、[[ACLR]]、EVM under Wi-Fi 7 modulation。
- RX analysis：[[EIS]] sensitivity verification。
- Spurious：Rx / OOB spurious emissions monitoring。
- Occupied bandwidth。
- Native Wi-Fi / IF / IB band：[[R&S CMP180]]。
- mmWave signal generation and analysis：[[R&S CMP200]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]]。
- R&D fine tuning：[[R&S FSW67]] 與 signal sources。
- Production / manufacturing setup：[[R&S CMQ200]] 與 automation SW WMT 只作為來源列名，尚無詳細流程。

R&S CMP200 › NR FR2 options 與 measurements
依 [[CMP200_Features_V8-14-22_en_09]] 與 [[CMP200_specs_en_5216-4391-22_v0800]]：

| Code | Name / 原文說明 | Order no. | 相依關係 / 限制 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| R&S CMP-KM601 | NR FR2 measurements, singlecarrier / NR mmWave measurements | 1212.1140.02 | NR FR2 measurements basic option |
| R&S CMP-KM603 | NR FR2 measurements, multicarrier / multi-carrier | 1212.2647.02 | 超過 1 carrier 需要此 option |
| R&S CMP-KM605 | NR FR2 measurements, two RX antennas / switched MIMO | 1212.3195.02 | Two RX antennas / switched MIMO |
| R&S CMP-KW601 | NR mmWave waveform playback | 1212.1163.02 | Enables R&S WinIQSIM2 waveforms for ARB generator |

NR FR2 multi-evaluation measurement 提供含 PUSCH 的 uplink signals 測試，measurement results 包含 Modulation、Spectrum、Power。Common settings 包含 number of carriers 1 to 4、operating band n257/n258/n259/n260/n261/n262、channel bandwidth 50/100/200/400 MHz、subcarrier spacing 60/120 kHz、duplex mode TDD、external attenuation –50 dB to 90 dB。

R&S ZNA26
[[R&S ZNA26]] 是 [[R&S ZNA]] 系列的 26.5 GHz Vector Network Analyzer 型號，依 Version 24.00（April 2026）規格書提供 2-port 與 4-port base unit。

朋程 › 限制與不可推論事項
- 「全球第一」是圖上用語；來源未提供排名口徑、市占率、年度、產品範圍或資料來源拆分。
- 來源未標示日期，因此不能把上述列名寫成特定時間點的市場現況。
- 來源是概念股整理表，不構成投資建議或供應鏈驗證。

無線通訊認證實驗室資料清單
[[無線通訊認證實驗室資料清單]]原本由 [[Test House]] 提供待讀材料索引；[[低軌衛星通信終端設備技術規範與相關檢測]]新增了[[電信技術中心]]在 111年08月簡報中的毫米波頻段測試量能描述；[[無線通訊認證實驗室]]則補入 `無線通訊認證實驗室.pptx` 的簡報正文摘要。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 可追溯範圍與限制
- 本頁目前由 [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]、[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 與 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 支撐。
- 本頁不推論 [[R&S CMX500]] 或 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 實際支援的 RF chains 數量、spatial streams 數量、MLO link combination、software option code 或 hardware configuration。
- 本頁不推論 [[Bluetest RTS65]]、其他 Bluetest RTS chambers 或 [[EMITE]] OTA chambers 的完整規格、measurement uncertainty、校準流程或 certification applicability。
- 本頁不把新聞稿中的 solution positioning 視為 conformance test coverage 或正式規格。
- [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 標示 [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18，但未提供 release date、release notes、license requirement 或相容性矩陣。
- [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 使用 full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] 的語句，但未展開 compliance 的測試項目、標準版本、認證機構或是否等同正式 conformance / certification testing。

R&S CMX500 OBT › 來源中的定位
[[CMW500 to CMX500OBT_License_Swap_Process]] 將 license swap 流程描述為 `License swap for OBT upgrades`，並以：

- Unit A：[[R&S CMW500]]。
- Unit B：[[R&S CMX500 OBT]]。

來表示從 CMW500 setup 升級到 CMX500 OBT 時的 keycode transfer target。

來源短版流程另寫明：Customers who upgrade their Setup2 to CMX500 OBT，R&S offers a license swap CMW500 → CMX500。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 描述為 CMX500 one-box signaling tester（OBT），可在 [[Bluetest]] RTS 中讓 developers 進行 realistic [[MIMO]] stress tests。該來源明確說 [[Bluetest]] 已將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 4G 與 [[5G NR]] test functionality 整合進 [[Bluetest Flow]] control software，並讓 developers 使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 在 [[Bluetest]] RTS 中執行 [[5G NR Standalone]]、[[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（EN-DC）與 [[LTE]] testing。

[[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 描述為 state-of-the-art one-box signaling tester，用於展示基於 [[3GPP Release 17]] specifications 的 [[5G NTN-NR]] connection。該來源說展示 setup 使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 與 [[MediaTek]] 的 NTN-NR device as DUT，並在 [[MWC Barcelona 2024]] 的 Rohde & Schwarz booth 展示 live 5G NTN-NR connection。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 驗證範圍
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]]：

- 驗證對象：[[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的 [[Next Generation eCall]] functionality。
- 合作方：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]]。
- 測試設備：[[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester。
- Software context：來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] with [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option can be effectively used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions。
- 標準：[[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 測試情境：simulating a [[PSAP]]。
- 驗證內容：NG eCall including voice and data transmission，並 validated the compliance of the implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024。

欣銓 › 限制與不可推論事項
- 來源未標示 Threads 原文發布日期。
- 來源未提供 [[欣銓]] 的測試項目、車用 / 功率 IC 占比、客戶、營收、產能或市占率。
- 「核心廠」是來源用語，缺少排名或供應關係證據。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

R&S CMP180 › Base unit 與硬體配置
依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]] ordering information：

| Designation | Type | Order no. |

| Radio communication tester, including power cables and getting started guide | CMP180 | 1201.0002K18 |
| CMP180 basic assembly | R&S CMP-PB18I | 1212.1986.10 |

依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]] 的 RF unit 描述：

- **R&S CMP-B802x**：僅支援 **250 MHz bandwidth**。
- **R&S CMP-B805x**：支援 **250 MHz bandwidth**，可用 **R&S CMP-K185** 啟用 **500 MHz**。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]：

- RF generator/analyzer no. 1：**8 × SnapN**，RF input/output to DUT，RF 1.1 to RF 1.8。
- RF generator/analyzer no. 2：**8 × SnapN**，RF input/output to DUT，RF 2.1 to RF 2.8；requires **R&S CMP-K102** or **R&S CMP-K105** software license key。

R&S ZNB3020 › 文件依據
- 來源：[[ZNB3000_specs_en_3647-5184-22_v0900]]。
- 文件：R&S®ZNB3000 Vector Network Analyzer Specifications。
- 文件編號：PD 3647.5184.22。
- 文件版本：Version 09.00。
- 發布時間：July 2026。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 與 3GPP / IEEE 的邊界
[[R&S for JIO Project]] 把 WoMT 的核心挑戰描述為 bridging the gap between IEEE and 3GPP：

- IEEE / Wi-Fi side：[[Wi-Fi 7]]、802.11be、native Wi-Fi signal、IF / IB band testing。
- 3GPP side：n257 / n258、27 GHz mmWave band、FR2 / mmWave-related test items。
- Regulatory / certification side：來源提到 [[SGS]]、Indian Government、government regulatory requirements，但未提供正式文件。

R&S CMPHEAD50 › mmWave RF analyzer
| 項目 | 規格 |
|---|---|
| 搭配 | [[R&S CMP200]] 與 [[R&S CM-Z30A]] |
| Duplex mode | half duplex（TDD） |
| RF frequency range | 21.84 GHz to 50.20 GHz |
| Connector type | RF 1、RF 2、Rx Low Noise In，front panel，wear adapter，2.4 mm（Q），female |
| Absolute maximum values | RF 1/RF 2 highest attenuation +22 dBm CW；RF 1/RF 2 lowest attenuation –8 dBm CW；Rx Low Noise In –10 dBm CW；0 V DC |
| Level uncertainty | 21.84 GHz < f < 31.8 GHz，–55 dBm to +15 dBm CW：< 2.5 dB；31.8 GHz < f < 50.2 GHz，–55 dBm to +10 dBm CW：< 3.0 dB |
| Additional uncertainty with external LO | Rx LO In +2 dBm to +4 dBm：< 0.3 dB |

Displayed average noise level 依 RF 1/RF 2 與 Rx Low Noise In、頻段分段；來源數值多為 < –154 dBm/Hz 到 < –165 dBm/Hz 範圍，引用前需回查來源表格。

R&S ZNA43
[[R&S ZNA43]] 是 [[R&S ZNA]] 系列的 43.5 GHz Vector Network Analyzer 型號，依 Version 24.00（April 2026）規格書提供 2.92 mm 與 2.4 mm test port interface 版本。

無線通訊認證實驗室資料清單 › 已擷取的無線通訊認證實驗室簡報內容
依 [[無線通訊認證實驗室]]：

- [[無線通訊認證實驗室]]用於測試與驗證無線設備符合法規、安全與性能標準，涵蓋 [[RF 測試]]、[[EMC]]、安規及一致性認證。
- 來源稱其可經 [[NCC]]、[[TAF]]、[[FCC]] 等機構認可，並支援 [[Global Market Access]] 與上市加速。
- 主要測試項目包含：頻譜、輸出功率、[[DFS]]、[[SAR]]、EMI / EMS、靜電放電、電源突波、[[Protocol 相容性]]、互操作性測試、[[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] 認證。
- 認證必要性包含防止電磁干擾與頻譜衝突、保障用戶安全、加速上市、降低召回與法律風險，以及滿足台灣供應鏈衛星終端、6G 等需求。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 來源中的測試架構
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）描述的架構為：

- [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 提供 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] control software / integrated test environment 整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS），例如 [[Bluetest RTS65]]，提供 reverberation chamber OTA environment。
- 測試對象為 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points。
- 測試目標為 MIMO stress testing under realistic conditions。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[Bluetest]] expanded its earlier integrated testing capabilities for [[WLAN]] stations and access points（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] 現在支援 bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。
- 此能力與 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 與 [[Bluetest]] RTS 組成 single tester and reverberation test system 的 integrated path。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[EMITE]] over-the-air chambers 可 combined with the latest sophisticated testing features of [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 整合 enables support of [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] and [[5G RedCap]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 non-cellular technologies including latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，all in a single instrument。
- [[EMITE]] customers obtain a comprehensive environment for accurately assessing performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] as well as [[5G RedCap]] devices。

Bluetest › 來源中的公司定位
- [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）稱 [[Bluetest AB]] based in Gothenburg, Sweden。
- 同一來源稱 [[Bluetest]] specializes in reverberation chambers，例如 [[Bluetest RTS65]]，用於 efficient over-the-air performance evaluation of wireless devices。

### Short answer
【推論】As automotive radar testing moves toward 76 GHz to 81 GHz mmWave frontends, dynamic FMCW artificial-object generation, and up to 5 GHz IF bandwidth, the VNA requirement expands toward mmWave coverage or converter support, wide-span IF characterization, time-domain measurement, fine frequency stepping, and high dynamic-range level measurement [40][34][8][9][15][25][3].
### Supported details
- Automotive radar echo generation in the passages includes dynamic artificial object generation; the digital concept is for FMCW radar, with maximum generated distance of 3000 m [34].  
- The automotive radar frontend bands listed include 76 GHz to 81 GHz for R&S AREG8-81S / AREG8-81D / AREG8-81WS / AREG8-81WD and R&S QAT100, while the AREG800A base unit instantaneous IF bandwidth can be 1 GHz, 2 GHz, or 5 GHz depending on option [40].  
- For AREG800A IF transfer characterization, the VNA measurement conditions are frequency step size 2.5 MHz, measurement bandwidth 1 kHz, source power –10 dBm, and spans including 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, and 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz [9].  
- For ghost-object suppression, the measurement condition explicitly uses a vector network analyzer in time domain with 125 kHz frequency step size, 100 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power, 2 m distance to the wanted artificial object, and spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz [8].  
- The R&S ZNA base VNA family covers up to 67 GHz, while the R&S ZNA67EXT VNA system covers 10 MHz to 110 GHz, so 76 GHz to 81 GHz radar work needs either higher-frequency VNA system coverage or mmWave converter support rather than only a base 67 GHz instrument [24][15][40].  
- R&S ZNA supports optional rear-panel LO output for mmWave converters, with up to four converters on a 4-port model and up to two converters on a 2-port model, without an external signal generator [25].  
- R&S ZNA performance figures relevant to level-sensitive measurements include dynamic range >129 dB without options, 147 dB typical with options, maximum attainable range up to 170 dB, and 100 dB typical continuous electronic power sweep range [3].

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。
- Speed example：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。

R&S AREG800A › Level 與 IF transfer characteristics
| 項目 | 條件 | 規格 |
|---|---|---:|
| Spurious free dynamic range | RX IF input to TX IF output connector at AREG800A base unit, measured at –10 dBm signal level, [[R&S AREG8-B9]] | `> 35 dBc (typ.)` |
| Spurious free dynamic range | [[R&S AREG8-B9]] with [[R&S AREG8-K527]] | `> 35 dBc (typ.)` |
| Spurious free dynamic range | [[R&S AREG8-B9]] with 未完整標示 option | `> 30 dBc (typ.)` |
| Suppression of ghost objects | measured from IF input to IF output connector at AREG800A base unit, [[R&S AREG8-B9]] | `> 40 dBc (meas.)` |
| Suppression of ghost objects | [[R&S AREG8-B9]] with 未完整標示 option | `> 40 dBc (meas.)` |

Suppression of ghost objects 量測條件：vector network analyzer in time domain；frequency step size `125 kHz`；measurement bandwidth `100 kHz`；source power `–10 dBm`；distance to wanted artificial object `2 m`；span 依 bandwidth 為 `1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz`、`0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz`、`0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz`。

R&S AREG800A › Level 與 IF transfer characteristics
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Dynamic RCS range for all artificial objects on one IF path：with [[R&S AREG8-24S]] / [[R&S AREG8-24D]] / [[R&S AREG8-81S]] / [[R&S AREG8-81D]] 為 `90 dB`；with [[R&S QAT100]] 為 `> 60 dB`。
- Dynamic RCS range for multiple objects per IF path：with [[R&S AREG8-24S]] / [[R&S AREG8-24D]] / [[R&S AREG8-81S]] / [[R&S AREG8-81D]] 為 `60 dB`；with [[R&S QAT100]] 為 `–`。
- RCS control step size：`0.1 dB`。
- Maximum input power at RX IF in connector of AREG800A base unit：`10 dBm (meas.)`。
- Recommended input power at RX IF in：`≤ 0 dBm (meas.)`。
- Maximum output power at TX IF out：`–3 dBm (meas.)`。
- IF attenuation accuracy of AREG800A base unit：`±2 dB (meas.)`。

Vector network analyzer 量測條件：frequency step size `2.5 MHz`，measurement bandwidth `1 kHz`，source power `–10 dBm`；span 依 bandwidth 為 `1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz`、`0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz`、`0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz`。

[[R&S AREG8-B9]] IF transfer characteristics：

R&S ZNA67EXT
[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 1.0 mm [[Vector Network Analyzer]] system，依 [[ZNA67EXT_specs_en_5216-3743-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（July 2025）涵蓋 **10 MHz to 110 GHz**。

R&S ZNA
[[R&S ZNA]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Vector Network Analyzer 系列，依 Version 24.00（April 2026）規格書涵蓋 [[R&S ZNA26]]、[[R&S ZNA43]]、[[R&S ZNA50]]、[[R&S ZNA67]]，頻率範圍從 10 MHz 延伸到最高 67 GHz。

R&S ZNA › 2-port / 4-port 架構
依 [[ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400]]（Version 24.00, April 2026）：

- 4-port instruments：最多 4 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 5 source 可作為 LO supply。
- 2-port instruments：最多 2 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 3 source 可作為 LO supply。
- 4-port model 每 port 有 2 true receivers，總計 8 true receivers；2-port model 每 port 有 2 true receivers，總計 4 true receivers；來源明確說明無 multiplexing。
- 支援 true parallel and coherent data acquisition，例如 antenna array tests 與 antenna test systems，從 100 kHz 開始。
- Optional rear panel LO out 可支援 mmWave converters；4-port model 最多 4 個 converters，2-port model 最多 2 個 converters，無需 external signal generator。
- Rear panel LO out 提供 high-power LO signal，typ. +25 dBm，最高 26.5 GHz，可作為 mixer measurements 的 LO source。
- Optional second LO source 可讓 mixer/frequency convertor measurements 速度加倍並最佳化 trace noise。
- 使用 [[R&S ZNA-K9]] option、1 kHz measurement bandwidth 時，mixer group delay 與 deviation from linear phase 的 group delay trace noise peak-to-peak 可由 200 ps 降至 15 ps。
- 最多 4 pulse modulators、最多 8 pulse generators（4-port）；最多 2 pulse modulators、最多 4 pulse generators（2-port）。
- Minimum pulse width：40 ns。
- Optional direct IF access（in/out）：IF input 可用於 mmWave converter 與 antenna measurement systems，bandwidth 1 GHz；IF output up to 2 GHz bandwidth 可用於 external pulse analysis。
- Selectable reference signal access：1 GHz external reference，可同步 external equipment，例如 signal generators，改善 mmWave converters up to terahertz frequencies 的 performance。

R&S AREG800A › Echo generation
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Echo generator type：`dynamic artificial object generation`。
- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
  - `digital`：用於 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 air gap value；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900 › 重點摘要
- Base unit instantaneous IF bandwidth 依 option 為 `1 GHz`、`2 GHz` 或 `5 GHz`；overrange 分別為 `1.2 GHz (meas.)`、`2.2 GHz (meas.)`、`5.2 GHz (meas.)`。
- AREG800A base unit IF frequency range：[[R&S AREG8-B9]] 為 `1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz`；[[R&S AREG8-B9]] with [[R&S AREG8-K527]] 為 `0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz`；來源另列 [[R&S AREG8-B9]] with [[R&S AREG8-K527]] 為 `0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz`，但 5 GHz bandwidth ordering information 顯示還涉及 [[R&S AREG8-K528]]，此處未自行推論修正。
- RF frequency bands：[[R&S AREG8-24S]] / [[R&S AREG8-24D]] 為 `24 GHz to 24.25 GHz`；[[R&S AREG8-81S]] / [[R&S AREG8-81D]] 與 [[R&S AREG8-81WS]] / [[R&S AREG8-81WD]]、[[R&S QAT100]] 為 `76 GHz to 81 GHz`；[[R&S FE44S]] 為 `24 GHz to 44 GHz`。
- 每台 [[R&S AREG800A]] base unit 支援 conventional mmWave frontends 最多 4 個，[[R&S QAT100]] 最多 8 個，[[R&S FE44S]] 最多 8 個 external frontends（4 個 TX、4 個 RX，共 4 pairs）。
- Artificial object distance 可依 option 涵蓋 `< 17 m to 3000 m (meas.)`、`< 4 m to 3000 m (meas.)`、`≥ air gap to 3000 m (meas.)`；production frontend 組合列為 FMCW `≥ air gap to 350 m (meas.)`，non FMCW `< 17 m to 350 m (meas.)`。
- Radial velocity：每個 artificial object 支援 individual Doppler frequency shift；with [[R&S AREG8-B9]] and [[R&S AREG8-B63]] velocity setting range 為 `±500 km/h`，velocity step size 為 `0.001 km/h`。
- Remote control interfaces 包含 Ethernet 與 [[R&S AREG8-K986]] GPIB；remote control command set 為 `SCPI`。
- HiL interface option 為 [[R&S AREG8-K109]]；open-standard protocol support 為 open simulation interface（OSI）；time synchronization protocol 為 `gPTP`、`NTP`。
- Base unit `AREG800A` Order No. `1437.4400.02`，包含 power cable 與 quick start guide。
